reviews.comment: Lauren was an amazing professor. You have 3 assignments due per week (textbook annotations, challenges based off the topic of the week, exit tickets). So simple and they don't take much effort at all, they can be timely though but you have an entire week to do each module. No exams, no midterm, no final. Great class!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things
